name: Hessian Estimation via Convolution
aliases: Second-order derivative estimation using the Hessian operator
definition: Second-order derivative estimation using the Hessian operator $D^H = \nabla^2 = \partial^2 / \partial\tau_i \partial\tau_j$, mapping a scalar function to an $n \times n$ Hessian field.
summary: Hessian Estimation via Convolution computes second-order spatial derivatives for differentiable rendering by convolving with a Gaussian-differentiation kernel, distinguishing itself by explicitly constructing the full Hessian matrix rather than marginalizing gradient components.
